title: Understanding the Update Rule
text: The update rule for gradient descent is given by: \( \theta**{(t+1)} $$=$$ \theta**{(t)} - \alpha \cdot \frac{d}{d\theta}L(\theta**{(t)}) \).

title: Substitute Known Values
text: Substitute \( \theta**{(0)} $$=$$ $$10$$ \), \( \theta**{(1)} $$=$$ $$11$$ \), and \( \alpha $$=$$ $$1$$ \) into the update rule.

title: Calculate the Gradient
text: Using the update rule \( \theta**{(t+1)} $$=$$ \theta**{(t)} - \alpha \cdot \frac{d}{d\theta}L(\theta**{(t)}) \), calculate \( \frac{d}{d\theta}L(\theta**{(0)}) \) when \( \theta**{(0)} $$=$$ $$10$$ \), \( \theta**{(1)} $$=$$ $$11$$ \), and \( \alpha $$=$$ $$1$$ \).
